description: This Java class 'DataEvents' handles content data operations such as uploading images, serving binary data, and creating/updating data resources within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for streaming content to browsers, security checks, and service invocations for data resource management.

classes.name: DataEvents
classes.description: Handles content data operations such as uploading images, streaming binary data, and managing data resources within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: uploadImage
methods.description: Uploads and stores an image resource using DataResourceWorker.

methods.name: serveObjectData
methods.description: Streams binary content data to the browser, with security and permission checks.

methods.name: serveImage
methods.description: Deprecated method to stream image data to the output.

methods.name: persistDataResource
methods.description: Creates or updates a DataResource record, making it available for content management.
